name: Anvil
author: Erin Carter
description: A near-black steel plate rung by hashed hammer blows: each strike floods four Chladni modes weighted by their shape at the impact point, so every blow glows a different nodal figure — dark fixed zero-curves between palette-tinted antinode lobes — that melts toward the slowest cross as the modes decay, leaving a faint residual until the next strike.

params.label: Strike gap
params.effect: Mean seconds between hashed hammer blows on the plate.

params.label: Ring time
params.effect: How long each figure takes to decay toward the residual after a blow.

params.label: Figure scale
params.effect: Continuously scales the mode wavenumbers, trading a few broad lobes for a finer many-lobed lattice.

params.label: Glint
params.effect: Brightness of the brief soft flash at the strike point, from invisible to a clear hammer spark.
